title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 241 ]

blocks.text: What is the purpose of education? It is to prepare the individual for the society in which he must live and to give him the power to change the society. We should not overemphasize the value of the first part. It should be one of the functions of education to preserve for the society all the values essential to it, but it is more important one to cut out the decayed values which would be harmful to a new society. Thus the school should be the inspiration to social change. Education should play the role in changing the society rather than in preserving its tradition .

readingSentences.english: What is the purpose of education?
It is to prepare the individual for the society in which he must live and to give him the power to change the society.
readingSentences.korean: 교육의 목적은 개인으로 하여금 개인이 살아가야 하는 사회에 적응하도록 준비시키는 것이고, 개인에게 사회를 변화시킬 수 있는 능력을 부여하기 위한 것이다.

readingSentences.english: We should not overemphasize the value of the first part.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 처음 부분의 가치에 지나치게 강조해서는 안됩니다.

readingSentences.english: It should be one of the functions of education to preserve for the society all the values essential to it, but it is more important one to cut out the decayed values which would be harmful to a new society.
readingSentences.korean: 그것은 사회에 필요한 모든 본질적인 가치를 유지시키기 위한 교육의 기능 중에 하나가 되어야 한다. 그러나 새로운 사회에 해가 될 진부한 가치를 제거하는 것이 더 중요하다.

readingSentences.english: Thus the school should be the inspiration to social change.
readingSentences.korean: 그러므로 학교는 사회변화에 대한 영감을 불어넣어야 한다.

readingSentences.english: Education should play the role in changing the society rather than in preserving its tradition .
readingSentences.korean: 교육은 전통을 유지하기 보다 사회를 변화시키는 기능을 수행해야 한다.
